newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products - fuel stronger, gas oil easier.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products - fuel stronger, gas oil easier.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed, with fuel a touch stronger and gas oil marginally weaker on Monday, traders said.
High sulphur fuel oil was notionally stronger and swaps were up by a dollar or two.

Greece issued a tender to buy 20,000 tonnes of straight-run fuel oil with a maximum sulphur content of 0.35 percent, to be delivered between March 5 and 10. Another 20,000 tonne cargo may be required, at the buyer's option, for delivery in April or May.
The tender closes on February 25 and is expected to be filled eventually with north African barrels.
Low sulphur cracked fuel oil was steady to firmer. Bids were heard at the equivalent of $110 cif Med, but no business was heard done.
Local Mediterranean demand for gas oil remains muted and prices were under prssure from good supplies of Russian material.
Easier IPE futures helped pull prices a touch lower. Mild temperatures has limited interest, traders said.
Russian was talked steady around high cif quotes -$1 to 75 cents cif Genoa while FOD was pegged around flat high fob quotes.
